activity_summary: The silver is spilled beside the opened boxes. Cuthbert's hand is still on a lid. Your hand is not in the picture, and your face is not.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not touch the lid.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: His hand is the one in the picture.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: The baize under the silver is his. He is not the hand.

entities.name: the boxes
entities.context: Mentioned in The silver, and a hand on a lid

facets.activity: Saw Cuthbert's hand on the lid
